resale_co.name: Resale Certificate of Inspection (Certificate of Inspection, Existing Structure Rental/Resale)
requirements: No open construction permits: have the Stafford Township construction clerk check, and close any open permits before applying
Mechanical certification that the heating unit, hot water unit, plumbing and electrical system are safe and working (by the owner, a licensed contractor or a home inspector)
Ocean County Board of Health well certificate for homes on a well
House numbers permanently attached, 4 inches tall
Deadbolts may not need a key on the inside
10-year sealed battery smoke alarms (or hardwired alarms) on every floor, including the basement, and outside each sleeping area
Carbon monoxide alarms within 10 feet of every bedroom
Water heater and boiler relief valves piped down to 6 inches from the floor
Metal dryer vent that ends outside
Hot water on the left, cold on the right; plumbing in good shape with no open sewer lines
Covers on all switches, outlets, junction boxes and panels, no gaps in the panel, and the electric service in good condition
No broken windows, missing siding, debris or uncut grass; chimneys and furnaces capped and vented; no holes in walls, floors or doors
Handrails and guardrails on open sides of decks and stairs 30 inches or more above grade; bulkhead maintained
Homes with a generator, solar or battery system need a 'Caution: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER' label within 18 inches of the main panel and the meter
resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the 2026 Inspection Application, fill in the Certificate of Inspection Application (seller, buyer and agent details, inspection type) and the Mechanical Certification page, and submit it with the fee to the Township of Eagleswood, 146 Division Street, West Creek. Cash, check or money order only, checks payable to Eagleswood Township. Then schedule the inspection with the Code Enforcement Officer, Monday and Thursday 3:30 pm to 7:30 pm, 609-296-3040 ext. 18.

evidence.quote: All Certificates of Occupancy for rental/resale must now be done through the Eagleswood Zoning Department @ 609-296-3040, ext. 18.

Pursuant to Eagleswood Township Ordinance 2001-14 and 8-10.0 all properties sold and rented shall have their heating unit, hot water unit, plumbing, and electrical system inspected and certified. Then the certification has to be delivered to the Zoning Official before a Certificate of Inspection can be issued.
Have Stafford Township construction clerk check for open permits. Should a property have any open permits, they MUST be inspected and closed out BEFORE this application can be submitted.
Schedule your inspection with the Eagleswood Township's Code Enforcement Officer. Monday & Thursday 3:30pm - 7:30pm (609) 296-3040 x18.
Zoning/Code Enforcement Officer [email protected] Phone 609.296.3040 Ext. 18 Hours: Monday & Thursday Only, 3:30pm-7:30pm

resale_co.notes: The Township posts one Inspection Application for both rentals and resales. For a sale with a buyer moving in, the form lists a Resale Certificate of Inspection ($40); a Transfer of Title inspection ($40) covers a sale with no occupancy. The ordinance text (ecode360 EA0480) could not be opened; the requirement is taken from the Township's own page and form. The Zoning/Code Enforcement Officer's email is hidden by the site's email protection and was decoded from the official page (wackley@eagleswoodtwpnj.us); the page does not print the officer's name, so no name is given. The form's fee sheet has no date; the file sits in the site's March 2026 upload folder (a 2025 version also exists). No lead time or validity period is stated. Rental properties also need a Rental Mercantile License and a water test within 5 years; that is a rental rule, not a resale rule. Construction permits and UCC inspections go through Stafford Township under a shared service agreement (609-597-1000, ext. 8563). The township's checklist says a fire extinguisher is a commercial requirement only.

requirements: Township resale checklist (2026): 10-year sealed battery smoke alarms (or hardwired) on every floor and outside each sleeping area, CO alarms within 10 feet of every bedroom, and a secondary power source label within 18 inches of the main panel and meter; fire extinguisher is a commercial requirement only

authorities.name: Not confirmed. The NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety is the fire code agency, but the state does not list Eagleswood as a town where it issues smoke certificates; the Township's Resale Certificate of Inspection checks smoke alarms, CO alarms and the power source label
authorities.how_to_apply: No separate smoke and CO certificate application or fee was found on the Township site. Ask the Township Zoning/Code Enforcement Officer (609-296-3040 ext. 18) whether the Resale Certificate of Inspection also serves as the state smoke and CO certificate, and ask the NJ DCA Bureau of Fire Code Enforcement (609-633-6132) whether it issues the certificate for Eagleswood.
authorities.contact_title: Fire Official (NJ Division of Fire Safety, state-enforced towns)

evidence.quote: LEAID: 1508-999 Enf Auth. State Fire Official Louis Kilmer Phone (609)633-6132 Addr: PO Box 809 Trenton NJ 08625-0809

Smoke Detectors: required on each floor of the structure, including basement, and outside of and in the immediate vicinity of each room used for sleeping purposes. Smoke detectors must be 10 year sealed battery powered single station smoke alarms.
Carbon Monoxide Detector: are required on the outside of and within 10 feet of any/all bedroom(s).

fire_cert.notes: The July 2026 LEA registry lists the State (S) as Eagleswood's fire code enforcing agency, and the state directory (Eagleswood is directory code 1508; Watchdog code 1509) names Louis Kilmer. But the DCA state-towns list (revised 7/17/2026) lists Eagleswood Twp without the 'SC' (smoke certs) flag, so the state does not appear to issue the smoke certificate here, and the directory's Smoke Detector Compliance block is blank. The Township's own resale inspection checks the same smoke alarm, CO alarm and secondary power label items, which suggests the Township handles it, but no official page says so. The state DCA online smoke fees were not applied here because the state does not mark Eagleswood for smoke certificates. The Eagleswood Fire Company (609-296-5151, 219 Railroad Avenue, West Creek) is a volunteer fire company, not the enforcing agency.

other_items.label: Open permits closed
other_items.detail: Stafford Township's construction clerk (shared service for Eagleswood UCC permits) must confirm there are no open permits; any open permits must be inspected and closed before the resale application is filed.

other_items.label: Mechanical certification
other_items.detail: Signed certification that the heating unit, hot water unit, plumbing and electrical systems are safe and working, by the owner, a licensed contractor or a home inspector, delivered to the Zoning Official.

other_items.label: Well certificate
other_items.detail: Ocean County Board of Health well certificate required for Transfer of Title and Resale inspections (for homes on a private well).

open_questions: Who issues the smoke and CO alarm certificate in Eagleswood: does the Township's Resale Certificate of Inspection count as the state certificate, or must sellers apply to the NJ DCA? The state list does not mark Eagleswood for state smoke certificates.
